stem: What were two reasons for the population patterns shown on this graph?
instruction: Study the graph and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: More passenger trains and better subway systems in the Sun Belt

options.label: G
options.text: More government regulation and fewer natural disasters in the Sun Belt

options.label: H

visual_elements: Line graph titled 'Total U.S. Population, by Region, 1940-2000' with population (millions) on the y-axis and decade on the x-axis; lines for South (solid), Midwest (dotted), Northeast (gray solid), and West (dashed). South shows steep increase, Midwest and Northeast moderate, West rising.
